songs.caption: gentle acoustic pop, warm female vocals, fingerpicked guitar, soft percussion, 95 bpm
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Morning light is on the floor
Kettle singing by the door
Nothing planned and nowhere far
Just the day and who we are

[Chorus]
Hold the light, hold it slow
Let the quiet help us grow
La la la, we are home
Nothing more to prove alone
